title: Inca builders construct Machu Picchu
summary: Inca builders created terraces, walls and buildings at Machu Picchu in the fifteenth century. The complex adapted construction and land use to a steep setting between the Andes and Amazon basin.

claims.text: Inca builders created terraces, walls and buildings at Machu Picchu in the fifteenth century. The complex adapted construction and land use to a steep setting between the Andes and Amazon basin.
Century-level construction date; no precise founding year is asserted.

The site highlights environmental adaptation and skilled stonework. Its fifteenth-century construction must remain distinct from later abandonment and the twentieth-century publicity surrounding its archaeological investigation.
